title: Call Recordings: Search, Play and Read the Transcript | CrestApps for Orchard Core
description:
When a customer says an agent promised something, or an agent needs coaching, a note is not enough. The Call recordings page in CrestApps for Orchard Core lists every recorded call in one place, with search, playback, a transcript for AI voice agent calls, and a way to erase a recording when you have to.

In this video:
• Why call recordings, and who sees which calls
• Which calls are recorded, and from when
• Searching by date, phone number, direction, call type and agent
• Playing a call and reading its transcript
• Erasing a recording
• Use cases for coaching, complaints, AI reviews and data deletion requests

chapters.title: Play a call and read the transcript
